1,139 |passengers=More than 219 |capacity=60 modular storage compartments |cargohandling= |consumables= |lifesupport=[[Life support|Enabled]] |communications=*Short range communications array (1) *Primary communications array (1) |othersystems=*Emergency command [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] *Vehicle repair bay *[[Droid]] repair bay *Aquatic species waterways |availability= |role=*[[Battleship]] *Heavy warship *[[Carrier]] *[[Flagship]] |firstuse= |retired= |affiliation=*[[New Republic]] **[[New Republic Defense Fleet]] *[[Resistance]] **[[Resistance navy]] *[[Citizens' Fleet]]{{Film|IX}} }} The '''MC85 Star Cruiser''', alternatively spelled '''MC-85 Star Cruiser''',[[Star Wars: Datapad|''Star Wars'': Datapad]] also known as the '''Resistance Cruiser '''or the '''Resistance Carrier''', was a [[Heavy cruiser|heavy]] [[Star Cruiser]] manufactured by the [[Mon Calamari Shipyards]] and the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation]] after the [[Galactic Civil War]]. It was used by the [[New Republic]] [[New Republic Defense Fleet|fleet]] and the [[Resistance]] [[Resistance navy|navy]]. ==Characteristics== ===Design and equipment=== [[File:MC85StarCruiser-BTCG.png|thumb|left|250px|The underside of an MC85.]] The MC85 Star Cruiser was a class of Heavy Star Cruiser that measured at a length of 3,438.37 meters. Jointly constructed by the Mon Calamari Shipyards and Corellian Engineering Corporation for service in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet]], the MC85's interior was designed to be more amenable to non-[[Amphibian|amphibious]] crew members, though it still had special waterways for aquatic species. Due to the New Republic's limited personnel, the MC85 was designed to be a highly automated ship, able to operate at full capacity with only skeleton crews. The MC85's primary command bridge was located at the bow of the ship, and contained a large [[holotable]] that could display the ship's status or that of its targets. In the event that the command bridge was left critically damaged, it also had a smaller emergency bridge located in the ventral area. Behind the emergency bridge was the vessel's large [[fuel]] storage; with the ion scoop particle collectors located beneath the fuel tanks. The cruiser was equipped with two large [[hangar]]s, one on the port and one on the starboard side of the ship. The MC85 contained repair bays for both vehicles and [[droid]]s, as well as several dozen modular storage compartments. ===Speed===
[[File:Raddus-engines.png|thumb|left|250px|The MC85's sublight ion engines gave it tremendous speed.]]
Despite its large size, the MC85 was a fast cruiser. Even nearly thirty years after commission, the ''Dawn of Tranquility'', in service with the Resistance under the name ''[[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|Raddus]]'', was still able to outrun the [[First Order]]'s modern [[battlecruiser]]s and the massive ''[[Supremacy]]''. Propelled by eleven sublight ion engines of different sizes, these massive ships were as fuel hungry as they were fast. ===Offensive and defensive systems=== As part of the [[New Republic]]'s [[Military Disarmament Act]], the MC85 was designed to put a greater emphasis on its defensive shields than its offensive firepower.''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' Hence, while undergunned for a typical ship of its size, featuring only a few dozen heavy [[turbolaser]]s, heavy [[ion cannon]]s, and [[point-defense laser cannon]] [[turret]]s in total as well as half a dozen [[proton torpedo launcher]]s, the MC85 compensated for this with highly durable advanced [[deflector shield]]s. These experimental shields that cocooned the ship were capable of repelling huge amounts of damage before failing, far more than most other ships. ==History== [[File:Raddus_Hyperspace_Tunnel.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Raddus'' served as the Resistance flagship during their [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the First Order.]] One ship, the [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|''Raddus'']], served as the flagship of the Resistance navy, and was crucial in the [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuation]] of [[D'Qar]]. The bridge of the ''Raddus'' was destroyed in the following [[Battle of Oetchi|battle]], and resulted in the deaths of most of the [[Resistance High Command]], including [[Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar]], when it was attacked by First Order [[TIE/sf space superiority fighter|TIE fighters]]. It was subsequently destroyed during the attack on the Resistance fleet when [[Vice Admiral]] [[Amilyn Holdo]] [[Holdo maneuver|purposefully entered hyperspace]] to crash into the ''[[Supremacy]]'', splintering the massive vessel in two, with the debris cutting through twenty escorting [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class]] [[Star Destroyer]]s. In [[35 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']] to one [[Standard year|year]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']]. As ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of ''The Force Awakens'' to [[34 ABY]], the events of ''The Rise of Skywalker'' must occur in [[35 ABY]]. MC85 Star Cruisers were part of a [[Citizens' Fleet|fleet]] assembled by [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] to assist the Resistance during the [[Battle of Exegol|battle]] against the [[Sith Eternal military|Sith Eternal forces]] over the [[planet]] [[Exegol]]. Several variants of the standard MC85 were present in the battle as well, including one with a vertical blade shape protruding below the bow, one lacking the pointed bow and having small protruding fins, and one with two angled wings near the stern. {{Ship-stub}} ==Behind the scenes==
